KlebelsbergAlignmentEvidence.role: Discussion of green-corridor cycling routes derived from planning context.
KlebelsbergAlignmentEvidence.factParaphrased: A former narrow-gauge railway embankment is identified between Klebelsberg-telep and the right-bank Tisza flood levee.
The same former embankment is listed as a network corridor. The text sends readers to annexes24and25 for proposals.
The same embankment is part of a green-corridor development concept. No quarter corner, Holt-Tisza endpoint or closed neighborhood boundary is specified.

comparisonWithFrozenGap.reason: The source corroborates a former physical embankment corridor linking the quarter toward the Tisza levee. That cycling alignment is not itself a whole-quarter boundary and does not identify the southern Holt-Tisza corner. Relevant detailed annex sheets are not included in the acquired123page PDF.
comparisonWithFrozenGap.remainingLead: Acquire an actual source-era embankment/quarter plan or the separately published detailed cycling annex maps; check complete embankment footprint and source-era waterbody corner. This PDF alone does not authorize a synthetic626m connector.
